Parse Fingertips period labels into dates

Source: R/fingertips.R
parse_fingertips_period.Rd

Fingertips labels time periods as text: "2015 Q1" (calendar quarter), "Nov 2014" (month), "2019/20" (financial year, April to March), "2019/20 Q2" (financial-year quarter) and "2019" (calendar year). This converts them to the first and last day of the period the label describes.

Usage

parse_fingertips_period(label)

Arguments

label

character vector of Fingertips period labels.

Value

A data.frame with columns period_start and period_end (class Date); NA for unrecognised labels.

Details

For indicators that are 12-month rolling series the value covers the twelve months ending at period_end; for other rolling series the window length is not stated by the API, so check the indicator definition.

Examples

parse_fingertips_period(c("2015 Q1", "Nov 2014", "2019/20", "2019/20 Q2", "2019"))
#>   period_start period_end
#> 1   2015-01-01 2015-03-31
#> 2   2014-11-01 2014-11-30
#> 3   2019-04-01 2020-03-31
#> 4   2019-07-01 2019-09-30
#> 5   2019-01-01 2019-12-31
